Actions.Text: AMEND (T) AND RECOMMIT TO ECONOMIC DEVELOPMENT

Title: Relates to the adoption of a good cause for disapproval standard for certain off-premises retail licenses
Summary: Relates to the adoption of a good cause for disapproval standard for certain off-premises retail licenses by the liquor authority.
ActClause: AN ACT to amend the alcoholic beverage control law, in relation to the adoption of a good cause for disapproval standard for off-premises retail licenses
